title: Circuit Breaker
description: Threshold-based and response-time based Circuit Breaker

failureRateThreshold.title: Failure rate threshold
failureRateThreshold.description: Failure (status code >= 500) rate threshold before the circuit breaker switches to the open state.

slowCallRateThreshold.title: Slow call rate threshold
slowCallRateThreshold.description: Slow call (response-time > slowCallDurationThreshold) rate threshold before the circuit breaker switches to the open state.

slowCallDurationThreshold.title: Slow call duration threshold (in millis)
slowCallDurationThreshold.description: The duration threshold above which calls are considered as slow and increase the slow calls percentage.

windowSize.title: Sliding windows size
windowSize.description: The size of the sliding window which is used to record the outcome of calls when the circuit breaker is closed.

minimumNumberOfCalls.title: Minimum number of calls
minimumNumberOfCalls.description: The minimum number of calls required, per sliding window period, before the circuit breaker can compute the error and slow call rates. A value greater than the sliding window size is capped to that size.

waitDurationInOpenState.title: Wait duration in open state (in millis)
waitDurationInOpenState.description: A fixed wait duration which controls how long the circuit breaker should stay open, before it switches to half open.

permittedNumberOfCallsInHalfOpenState.title: Permitted number of calls in half-open state
permittedNumberOfCallsInHalfOpenState.description: The number of calls allowed through while the circuit breaker is half-open. The circuit closes again only once they have all been recorded, so a single failing call no longer condemns the circuit for a whole cycle.

maxWaitDurationInHalfOpenState.title: Maximum wait duration in half-open state (in millis)
maxWaitDurationInHalfOpenState.description: The longest the circuit breaker may stay half-open before switching back to open on its own. Zero, the default, means it waits indefinitely for the permitted calls to be recorded. Set it to a non-zero value to guarantee the circuit always leaves the half-open state, even if a permitted call is never recorded.

recordInterruptedCallsAsFailures.title: Record interrupted calls as failures
recordInterruptedCallsAsFailures.description: Record a call interrupted before the backend answered — a gateway request timeout for instance — as a failure, provided it lasted longer than the slow call duration threshold. Shorter interruptions, typically a client giving up, stay ignored.

redirectToURL.title: Redirect call to URL
redirectToURL.description: Redirect the call to the given URL instead of returning a '503 Service Unavailable' status (supports EL).
